section.42: Model Behavior of the Prophet (Kitab Al-Sunnah)

42.name_native: Model Behavior of the Prophet (Kitab Al-Sunnah)

hadiths.text: Ubayy b. Ka’b said :I heard the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) explaining the verse “As for the youth his parents were people of Faith,” he was created infidel the day when he was created
